title: 基于概率程序的后训练方法提升大语言模型归纳推理能力
summary: 提出PPT方法，利用LLM生成概率程序场景，通过概率推理产生分布化软标签进行微调，显著提升LLM在归纳推理任务上的估计精度、与人类判断的一致性，并改善校准能力。
summary_en: Proposes PPT, using LLMs to generate probabilistic program scenarios, performing probabilistic inference to produce distributional soft labels for fine-tuning, substantially improving estimation accuracy, alignment with human judgments, and calibration on inductive reasoning tasks.
